title: The eight-piece Olinca band
summary: Describes the eight-piece band with two trumpets, sax, clarinet, trombone, bass, banjo and drums that read orchestrations.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: I played with the Olinca band. He had an eight-piece band. As I know, the pass on drum and the album of Tablet, trumpet. He had a Henry Julian on saxophone. Is that a sax and clarinet? Yeah. It used, yeah, we used two trumpets, sax and clarinet, made of eight pieces. No trombone? Yeah, one trombone, bass and a banjo. What would he have on saxophone? Sometimes it would be Hoybert Moran, different fellas. For a while he had whatever it was Moran.
So many of them. Yeah. Did they play from sheet music? It's a big band. Well, yeah.
